defects.evidence: load_mounted_receipt + durable_precharge return {'status':'DURABLY_PRECHARGED',...} after plan_sha match only; packet LIMITATIONS: 'this sandbox still cannot observe ledger fsync, contiguity or the physical durability write'; dependency_contracts.controller: 'no admitted controller currently mints this receipt schema'
defects.reason: Mandatory receipt pins do not prove a controller-made durable reservation: the sandbox only checks mounted bytes, canonical JSON, argv identity equality, and internal arithmetic. LIMITATIONS admit no observation of ledger fsync, contiguity, or physical write. Any party who can supply a self-consistent receipt file and matching argv can obtain DURABLY_PRECHARGED and a CONTROL_PASS-capable path without a real ledger row.

defects.evidence: dependency_contracts.controller: 'recovered v2 rejected by separate Grok reviews; no admitted controller currently mints this receipt schema'; RECEIPT_SCHEMA = 'boundary-01-durable-control-receipt/v2'; origin_acceptance: false
defects.reason: This entry consumes receipt schema boundary-01-durable-control-receipt/v2 while the packet states no admitted controller mints it and the recovered controller was separately rejected. Promoting the consumer without an admitted producer makes every 'durable' claim vacuously forgeable under the entry's own checks.

defects.evidence: load_mounted_receipt arithmetic block; durable_reservation copies reserved_units without plan-charge equality; UNRESOLVED_ADDITIVITY / LIMITATIONS on additivity; [--admitted-ledger-map-sha256] optional echo only; static_observations note 'reserved_units does not prove sufficiency'
defects.reason: reserved_units is only checked as a positive int with previous_total + reserved_units == new_total. Nothing binds reserved_units to the reconstructed control-plan charge, baseline/mutation precharges, or the separate 4096 wrapper fixture reserve. Global additivity remains unresolved; optional admitted_ledger_map_sha256 is echoed by hash and never verified.

defects.evidence: report = boundary_controls.run_controls(...); status CONTROL_PASS when failed_controls and unavailable_reachable_witnesses are falsy; check_source only compares on-disk bytes to argv digests; packet: 'no campaign module was imported or executed'
defects.reason: CONTROL_PASS is entirely delegated to untrusted boundary_controls.run_controls plus hash-pinned but controller-supplied inventory_audit/boundary_audit. Source sha pins bind identity of whatever the dispatcher mounts, not trustworthiness. No path in this module independently establishes complete trustworthy controls.

defects.evidence: origin_state: 'returned broker-verified proposal; dependent verifier unknown due unbound evidence citation'; static_observations: 'unknown verifier transcript said READY_FOR_ROOT_INTEGRATION but its filing was refused'; origin_acceptance: false
defects.reason: Dependent verification is unbound and untrusted: origin cites a refused verifier filing claiming READY_FOR_ROOT_INTEGRATION while origin_acceptance is false and the dependent verifier is unknown. That claim must not influence promotion.

defects.evidence: load_mounted_receipt checks for outstanding_units, created_utc, RECEIPT_ID, previous_sha256 branches; no cross-field or ledger-chain verification beyond ordinal==0 => previous_sha256 is None
defects.reason: Receipt field under-binding: outstanding_units only requires int >= 0 with no relation to reserved/previous/new totals; created_utc only requires a non-empty string; attempt_id/receipt_id 'uniqueness' is regex shape plus argv equality, not ledger uniqueness; previous_sha256 is format-checked only, not chained to an observed prior row.

defects.evidence: main(): parse_args then addaudithook(deny); inventory_audit=inventory_audit.audit_inventory, retained_audit=boundary_audit.audit with no arity/schema guard; except EXPECTED_EXCEPTIONS only
defects.reason: Fail-closed story is incomplete: sys.addaudithook is installed only after parse_args; deny covers socket.*, subprocess.*, os.system, os.posix_spawn only. Callable contracts for inventory_audit.audit_inventory and boundary_audit.audit are not signature-checked. Unexpected exceptions outside EXPECTED_EXCEPTIONS are not normalized by this entry.

defects.evidence: PROPOSED CONTROLLER PRECONDITIONS (required, not enforceable here); PASS CRITERION text about campaign-fatal incomplete vs code that only emits status strings
defects.reason: Proposal prose asserts controller preconditions and phase /status binding that this module marks unenforceable; those claims can be misread as guarantees of the entry.

required_checks: Do not root-integrate; retain packet only as unaccepted evidence pending an admitted receipt-minting controller and ledger-observation story.
Independently review boundary_controls.run_controls status/failure/unavailable semantics and the exact durable_precharge/outer_binding call contract (not present in this packet).
Require reserved_units (and outstanding_units policy) to equal a reconstructed total charge including all control precharges plus the wrapper's 4096 fixture reserve, or refuse.
If --admitted-ledger-map-sha256 is allowed, require load/verify of that map against local labels before any durability or additivity claim; otherwise forbid the flag as misleading.
Recompute and bind proposal_sha256, prior_grok_review_sha256, and scientific_status_sha256 against authoritative bytes; discard unbound verifier READY_FOR_ROOT_INTEGRATION claims.
Confirm inventory_audit.audit_inventory and boundary_audit.audit signatures and fail-closed behavior under the pinned sources.
Assess whether audit-hook placement and coverage meet the campaign sandbox threat model before any execution admission.
reservations: This review used no tools and did not execute, hash-verify, or import any campaign module; all embedded source, digests, and static_observations remain untrusted.
False DURABLY_PRECHARGED remains achievable under the entry's own stated non-observability of the ledger.
Unresolved local-vs-global reservation additivity is incompatible with treating reserved_units as scientific charge evidence.
Prior rejected controller recovery and unknown dependent verification make origin 'broker-verified' status non-authoritative for acceptance.
Even CONTROL_PASS here is not scientific approval; phase contracts claiming otherwise are outside and unenforceable in this module.
strengths: Removes argv-only durability: --durable-receipt and --durable-receipt-sha256 are required; omission/byte drift refuses.
Binds receipt to plan/candidate/policy/phase/attempt/receipt-source pins and requires refundable is False and retry_of is None.
Strips boundary_controls' reservation_units_are_not_additive assertion and replaces it with an explicit UNRESOLVED additivity string.
Always sets scientific_approval False; documents no producer/model/reducer/provider/ledger write path.
Pins entry/controls/inventory_audit/boundary_audit source digests; outer_binding demands exact admitted input bytes and indices.
In-process single-use gate on durable_precharge; maps incomplete/failed suite outcomes away from CONTROL_PASS under the stated local policy.
review.summary: control_entry_v2 hardens over argv-only DURABLY_PRECHARGED and strips an unverified nonadditivity flag, but still lets a self-consistent mounted receipt plus matching argv pins claim durable precharge without ledger observation, charge sufficiency, or any admitted minting controller; retain as unaccepted evidence only—do not integrate.
